description: Global Energy Monitor publishes asset-linked financing information for coal-fired power projects worldwide. The Global Coal Project Finance Tracker records transactions from 2010 onwards, connecting projects to financiers, finance types, destination countries and financial-close dates. Public summaries use US dollars and financed capacity in megawatts. The inspected provider page identifies an August 2026 release and offers a map, dashboard and downloadable database; its metadata repository describes an earlier Excel release. Access is free under GEM’s default CC BY 4.0 policy unless otherwise noted. A limitation is that only financing explicitly earmarked for projects is included: general corporate finance and Chinese coal-plant financing are excluded, and plants without financing evidence do not appear on the map. Simulation uses include constructing finance dependencies and conditioning proposed capacity on funding progress. It complements data-gem-global-coal-plant-tracker, which covers the underlying physical plant inventory. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. Metadata and methodology were checked without downloading the financial database or treating announced finance as completed construction.
